subject: Request to shift Tue demo — need time for sample data ingest and onsite prep
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinLytics Demo Ops <demo-ops@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to move Tuesday demo — need time for sample data ingest and onsite prep

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for putting the demo on the calendar for next Tuesday (30 Nov). Two things came up on our side: the engineering team needs an extra 48 hours to ingest a subset of our production traces, and our ops lead who was planning to be onsite has a travel conflict that moves their arrival to Wednesday evening. Between those two items, were worried we wont get meaningful throughput numbers during the demo if we keep the original slot.

Could we look at moving the session 24–48 hours later? Preferably Wednesday or Thursday afternoon PT. We want to make sure you can run with our sample payloads, and we can provide the ingest file and network details ahead of time. Ill attach the sample payload and a short ops note.

Appreciate the flexibility — were excited to see the latency/cost breakdowns with our traces.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Director of Data Platforms | FinLytics

Attachments: sample_payload_v2.csv (7 KB), network_ingress_instructions.pdf (14 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to move Tuesday demo — need time for sample data ingest and onsite prep

Elena,

Thanks for the heads up and the attachments — those look helpful. We can absolutely shift the demo later to give your team time to finish the ingest. Two quick asks so we can replan: 1) can you confirm the sample scope (rows, tokenization expectations) — the CSV helps but a short note on expected sequences would be great; 2) do you have a preferred fallback slot (Wed 2–4pm PT or Thu 11–1pm PT)?

Marissa, Connor  looping you both to check availability on our side and to raise the ask for a slightly longer run window (we should reserve an extra 30 mins for ingest validation). Marissa, can you also pre-stage the runbook and ensure the KV cache settings match their typical prompt lengths? Connor, can you confirm if we need a dedicated GPU pool for the run (or if shared capacity will hit their throughput)?

If we lock a new slot today Ill update the calendar and send updated pre-demo instructions to FinLytics.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
